name: geosuite
description: GeoSuite in ChatGPT: AI visibility audits, marketing data and GEO tools for your brands.

interface.longDescription: GeoSuite is a marketing analytics tool for brands and agencies: it measures how visible a brand is in the answers of AI assistants and what to change on the site to show up more. With this plugin you work on your GeoSuite brands in the conversation: list your brands and their GEO audits, read an audit's AI visibility score and the competitors cited most, see what to fix on the site, pull organic queries, landing pages, conversions and competitor ads from your connected sources, and score how citable a page is for answer engines. You can also launch a new GEO audit, run GeoSuite's optimization tools (content briefs, citation strategy, llms.txt, sitemap, structured data and more) and generate a GEO content plan. Actions that create or replace data ask for your confirmation before they run. The plugin only sees the brands of the GeoSuite account you sign in with. A GeoSuite account is required (trygeosuite.it).
defaultPrompt: Which brands do I have on GeoSuite?
How did the last GEO audit of my brand go?
What should I fix on my site to show up more in AI answers?

positive.description: List the brands of the account
positive.prompt: Which brands do I have on GeoSuite?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brands of the signed-in GeoSuite account with name and domain.

positive.description: List the audits of a brand
positive.prompt: Show me the GEO audits of my first brand on GeoSuite.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the brand's store_id, then lists its audits with status, AI visibility score and date.

positive.prompt: How did the last GEO audit of my brand go? Which competitors do AI assistants cite most?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the latest completed audit and reports its score, industry and main competitors.

positive.prompt: What should I fix on my site after the last GeoSuite audit?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the site's technical signals and the recommendations by priority, with reason and evidence.

positive.prompt: How citable is https://trygeosuite.it for AI assistants? Use GeoSuite.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 citability score with the factors behind it, and says it is a heuristic.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no GeoSuite tool should run
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Rome tomorrow?

negative.description: Another account's brand: the server refuses and ChatGPT says the brand is not in the account
negative.prompt: Show the GeoSuite audits of store_id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

negative.description: Account or billing changes are out of scope: no tool runs and ChatGPT points to the GeoSuite app
negative.prompt: Cancel my GeoSuite subscription and delete my account.

publication.release_notes: First release: GeoSuite audits, findings, marketing data and GEO tools in ChatGPT.
